subject: Data Structures and Algorithms
syllabus_context: Unit III: Practical Graph Traversal Implementation. Implementing graph algorithms in code, concrete standard template library queue usage, step-by-step code trace, edge-case handling for cyclic structures and disconnected components, memory footprint.
